pilots: training prompts only: per-band gain ladders for the 4 concepts set HI; five box scalings on 24 random designs each chose SCALE .6 with a cube (uniq 5/50/95 .48/.62/.72; tiers met 4, 13, 23 of 24)

methods.gmoo: design of experiments, one model, then each cell as one query: maximize each raised concept, minimize each lowered one, uniq and coh at least the tier, drift at most drift_max; query_iter evaluations
methods.additive: the band lines give each output as base plus a sum of one-band curves (linear interpolation in u); each cell is solved on that model by differential evolution on the baselines' loss, the answer evaluated, the model shifted by the observed residual and solved again, query_iter evaluations per cell
methods.line: steer@2's knob: one raw gain on every band of the task's concepts (negative for a lowered one), the line grid per task
methods.band: the best band-line point, one band of one concept at a time
methods.de: differential evolution on the cell at tier 2 (the baselines' loss: minus the score plus a steep penalty outside the cell), de_maxiter generations of 24, per task
methods.lookup: the best point of the design of experiments

claims.depth: at tier 2, on the held-out prompts, for at least 3 of the 4 single-concept tasks the best of the other methods' designs beats the uniform line's best design by at least log10(2)
claims.model: over the 24 task-tier cells on the held-out prompts, globalMOO beats the additive model in more cells than it loses; the same count against line, band, de and lookup is reported whichever way it falls
